entity.summary: Hardware-wallet and cryptographic security-device ecosystem centered on the GridPlus Lattice1 hardware wallet.
entity.notes: Current first-party GridPlus documentation identifies GridPlus as a hardware-security-device manufacturer and Lattice1 as its flagship wallet. Initial GridPlus wallet launch date remains unresolved.

products.summary: GridPlus Lattice1 hardware wallet using a secure enclave for private-key generation, storage and signing.
products.notes: Current first-party documentation establishes the product and on-device secure-enclave key boundary. Sales status remains unknown in this batch because the reviewed documentation does not itself establish current purchase availability.

evidence.title: GridPlus Brand Assets
evidence.notes: First-party GridPlus documentation identifies GridPlus as a manufacturer of hardware security devices and Lattice1 as its flagship wallet.

evidence.title: Lattice1 Security Features
evidence.notes: First-party security documentation states Lattice1 private keys are generated, stored and used for signing inside a secure enclave on the device.

evidence.title: GridPlus SDK
evidence.notes: Official GridPlus organization repository for the SDK used to integrate with Lattice1; the repository is not archived. This supports continuing integration availability but is not by itself a full hardware support commitment, so promotion should remain conservative.
